summary: Iteration 29 — Project completion new schema + Apple-style PDF hero + AI removal. CRITICAL FRONTEND BLOCKER found and fixed: /app/frontend/src/pages/ProjectDetails.js had a stray duplicated JSX block at lines 1271-1307 (orphan code outside the closing function brace) causing the entire frontend to FAIL TO COMPILE with 'Missing semicolon (1271:12)'. Removed those 37 orphan lines — frontend now compiles cleanly and the login flow + dashboard load fine. Backend: 6/6 new pytest tests pass in test_iteration29_complete_flow.py — (a) missing completion_drive_link → 400 'Completion Drive link is required', (b) invalid url 'not-a-url' → 400 'Completion Drive link must be a valid URL', (c) valid drive link + full inverter_login dict on approved project → 200, project.status='completed', GET round-trips completion_drive_link + inverter_login {url,username,password,notes} + customer_feedback intact, (d) legacy completion_media-only POST still 200 with status=completed and empty drive link, (e) GET /api/projects/{id} always returns completion_drive_link='' and inverter_login={} defaults, (f) custom_fields.proposed_solution {system_kw,panel_count,inverter_kw,panel_area,notes} round-trips through MongoDB on POST→GET. Frontend code review (grep) confirmed: (1) Complete dialog has ALL required testids — completion-drive-link-input, inverter-url-input, inverter-username-input, inverter-password-input, inverter-password-toggle, inverter-notes-input, customer-feedback-input, confirm-complete-btn. (2) confirm-complete-btn IS disabled when completionDriveLink.trim() is empty. (3) completion-media-upload-area is ABSENT (good). (4) ai-recommendation-btn and smart-suggestions-card are ABSENT from SiteVisitForm.js (good). (5) proposed-solution-card with all 5 inputs (proposed-system-kw-input/proposed-panel-count-input/proposed-inverter-kw-input/proposed-panel-area-input/proposed-notes-input) present at SiteVisitForm.js line 896. (6) Apple-style PDF hero strings 'At a Glance — What this means for you', 'You invest', 'You save monthly', 'Cost recovered in', 'Total saved (25 yrs)' present at ProjectDetails.js lines 564-571. MISSING IMPLEMENTATION: The display-side 'Completion & Handover card' is NOT in ProjectDetails.js — there is NO data-testid='completion-handover-card', NO data-testid='completion-drive-link' (display variant), NO data-testid='reveal-inverter-pwd', NO data-testid='copy-inverter-pwd'. Only the dialog (write) version exists.

rca of the issue: Frontend was failing to compile because /app/frontend/src/pages/ProjectDetails.js had 37 lines of orphan JSX (1271-1307) sitting AFTER the component's closing brace '}'. This stray block was clearly a duplicate of the Complete Dialog body (lines 1234-1267) that the previous edit failed to remove. Webpack/babel reported 'Missing semicolon (1271:12)'. Fix: deleted lines 1271-1307 — file ends cleanly at line 1270 with '}'. Reproduction: ProjectDetails.js fails to parse with babel. Mitigation in this iteration: file truncated to 1270 lines, frontend now compiles successfully. Suggest adding a pre-commit lint that runs `yarn build` to catch JSX-outside-function errors.
